x: The programme started with the sprint heats and D. Gratte soon brought himself well into the limelight by recording fast time from his mark in the Under 19 event.

Pack gained a very narrow lead on the first "leg" over Burroughs, of Mitcham A.C., the Surrey County Junior champion, and this was increased considerably by R. Macpherson and D. Gratte, who breasted the tape an easy winner.
